app_memory.decision: Eight logical APP banks, canonical P-lane vector words, scheduler-boundary global 2R+2W envelope, and latency-neutral physical wrapper that supports any R2-aligned same-bank read/write collision without adding a cycle.

initialization.inactive_lane_rule: logical zero and masked from updates

ACC_pipeline.A0: ACC issue c: APP source selection and forward QC permutation
ACC_pipeline.A1: c+1: old C2V reconstruction and q
ACC_pipeline.A2: c+2: B=2 accumulation update and q/sign publication

REC_pipeline.R0: REC issue c: new C2V reconstruction

latency.ordinary_ACC_source_cycle: stored or forwarded APP must be logically available during A0 cycle c

logical_word.basis: one active base column in canonical orientation

physical_wrapper_requirement.a0_source_requirement: stored APP source must be logically available during A0 cycle c for QC permutation; a bare one-cycle synchronous BRAM read that makes APP first available in A1 does not satisfy this interface
physical_wrapper_requirement.read_during_write_same_address_dependenc: not relied upon; forwarding supplies not-yet-memory-safe values
physical_wrapper_requirement.reason: R2 writes occur c+3, not at schedule issue c; the reference program has same-bank physical read/write cycles.
physical_wrapper_requirement.required_behavior: support one read and one write to the same logical bank in the same physical cycle, or use an equivalent write buffer/register shadow, with no added visible latency

suggested_xilinx_realizations: register or LUTRAM bank store for latency-critical A0 source access
BRAM/URAM payload behind a register shadow, cache, or other latency-neutral wrapper that preserves A0 source availability
LUTRAM/register shadow for the latency-critical high-rate profile
write-buffered bank wrapper with c+4 ordinary-read safety and c+3 forwarding

compressed_check_state.decision: Use two logical generation arrays plus per-layer epoch/valid/closed metadata. ACC reads old generation, A2 writes new generation, REC reads newly closed generation.

first_iteration.initial_block_setup: leaves the old generation logically invalid
first_iteration.oldC2V: if old generation is invalid for the current block/epoch, reconstructed oldC2V = 0

layer_close.Imin_after_close: must name a real local edge ID
layer_close.visibility: closing ACC issue c -> closed new generation visible c+3

ownership.A2: new generation update and layer close publication
ownership.iteration_advance: after syndrome decision, new generation becomes old for the next iteration; previous old becomes next write target

ports_required.per_A2_cycle: one context update plus up to two new q_sign edge-vector writes
ports_required.per_ACC_issue: one old-generation layer-vector read plus up to two old q_sign edge-vector reads
ports_required.per_REC_issue: one new-generation layer-vector read plus up to two new q_sign edge-vector reads

suggested_xilinx_realizations: register or LUTRAM layer context for running and just-closed minima
duplicated/striped q_sign storage for B=2 edge-vector reads
BRAM/LUTRAM arrays behind a wrapper that preserves c+3 close visibility

forward_cache.aux_encoding: ACC/REC aux values 1..8 encode slots 0..7; 0 means no forward source/allocation

validated.memory_safe_rule: REC issue c -> ordinary APP memory safe c+4
validated.valid_cycle_rule: REC issue c -> forward visible c+3

logical_read_latency_table.bypass_requirement: If ACC aux selects a forward slot, APP memory is not read; the forward slot APP follows the same A0 timing and must be available during c for QC permutation.
logical_read_latency_table.consumer_stage: A0 source selection and forward QC permutation; A0 result is registered for A1 at c+1

logical_read_latency_table.bypass_requirement: If the old generation is invalid for the current block/epoch, reconstruction returns logical zero; no M1/M2/Imin sentinel is observed.
logical_read_latency_table.consumer_stage: A1 reconstructs oldC2V with old q_sign

logical_read_latency_table.bypass_requirement: Same invalid-old-generation zero rule as old compressed layer state.
If closing ACC issues at x, new state is visible at start x+3; a REC issued at c=x+3 may consume that newly published state during R0 c.
Must match the new compressed layer-state generation and iteration epoch; mismatch is fatal.
A read at the q write-visible boundary must return the written q vector or be proven absent by schedule validation; no hidden cycle is allowed.
logical_read_latency_table.consumer_stage: R1 computes APP update with q and newC2V

q_scratch.decision: Two q buffers, ten valid q slots per buffer, one B-vector write and one B-vector read per cycle, with explicit owner metadata.

timing.read_allowed: REC issue cycle >= write_visible and layer closed
timing.read_latency: request in R0 cycle c, data valid in R1 cycle c+1
